description: This file is a shell script used for testing the 'git' command, specifically testing the 'git rm' command with the --pathspec-from-file option. It includes setup, test cases, and validations for different scenarios involving file removals using pathspecs.

methods.name: restore_checkpoint
methods.description: Resets the git repository to the checkpoint tag, restoring the initial state.

methods.name: verify_expect
methods.description: Verifies the current git status against the expected output stored in 'expect'.

calls: git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no -- fileA.t fileB.t fileC.t fileD.t
